name: Hours of nothing let a fed-up mood go, a step at a time
case: A test fails and then the agent's turn fails, so Boop gets fed up: irritated or grumpy. Then nothing at all happens for hours. Each hour of nothing lets Boop calm down a step: after the first it's no longer grumpy, and by the third it's calm again, with a calm face at most.
why: characters/boop/steering/guide.md: after an hour of nothing a mood fades a step toward calm, along the mood graph; the hourly heartbeat is the event that brings it, and a heartbeat itself is no reason to say anything. characters/boop/steering/mood/annoyed.md: a turn failing after a failed check leaves annoyed for grumpy (a jump a failed turn earns) or irritated
